|lore=Stormtroopers blasted through the main airlock of the Tantive IV. The Rebel soldiers' attempt to defend the intrusion was no match for the Empire's superior firepower.
|game_text=Deploy on a captured starship. Your characters present with captured starship may battle opponent’s characters aboard it (as if present together at a site). Effect canceled if starship escapes or is stolen.

* Printed face: [[Besieged]]
* Actual Decipher source: [[:File:ANH-D-Besieged-Decipher-Glossary-1998-p25-entry.png]], Glossary (1998), PDF page 25. Later PC full face: [[Besieged (PC Errata 3)]].
|rulings=* In the November 1998 Glossary’s explanatory discussion, Besieged remains on the starship regardless of which side controls it, until that starship is no longer on table.<ref name="besieged-decipher-1998-discussion">[[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Decipher Glossary Version 2.0]] (November 1998), Besieged entry, PDF page 25.</ref>
* That 1998 discussion describes escape when Dark has no characters present with the targeted starship. Light may return it to the appropriate system or sector, or choose its Used Pile; a permanent pilot on the holding Star Destroyer does not prevent that escape.<ref name="besieged-decipher-1998-discussion" />
* The later final Decipher Glossary Supplement, whose cover is updated 29 January 2002, describes release when the tractor beam card is canceled. It returns the held starship to Light’s side of the system or sector, or to the Used Pile at Light’s option. This is the dated supplement’s capturing-starships rule, separate from the 1998 explanatory discussion.<ref>[[Media:Decipher_Glossary_Supplement.pdf|Decipher Glossary Supplement]], cover updated 29 January 2002, capturing starships entry, PDF page 11.</ref>

* The primary illustration is the actual 1998 document excerpt. The credited [[:File:ANH-D-besieged-errata-hires.webp|strangewayes print-ready full-card rendition]] is retained as an explicit later comparison; it is not a scan of this historical document. It uses the same replacement words, but the source type and gold E mark differ. The automatic same-version High-Res Scan association has therefore been removed; the file and its credit remain.
* The further discussion in the 1998 entry and current Advanced Rulebook differ on release/stealing and where the Effect goes. The final Decipher [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_Supplement.pdf|Glossary Supplement]], cover updated January 29, 2002, already provides tractor-beam-cancellation release in its capturing-starships entry (PDF page 11). This is not attributed to the Players Committee. The exact source chronology of every later nuance is not established here. Historical explanatory rulings are not silently applied to later editions; see Advanced Rulebook (2023), PDF pages 138 and 163.
